All 70 test cases produced valid output (score > 0).
arms.diagnostic_note: The ~4.5 point gap from the designer probe (76.21 vs 71.76) warrants investigation in iter-2. arms.predicted: The naive strip packer will score approximately 30-35, because placing pieces in a 1D horizontal strip wastes vertical space — only the tallest piece determines height, leaving most columns with empty cells above.
arms.observed: SCORE: 34.59. The strip packer achieves exactly the predicted packing efficiency. All 70 test cases produced valid output.

discrepancy_analysis: Both arms confirmed directional predictions. h-main scored 71.76 (predicted ~76), h-control-negative scored 34.59 (predicted ~34). The 2.07x improvement from skyline packing confirms that 2D spatial awareness is the dominant mechanism for packing density. The magnitude gap between the probe (76.21) and experiment (71.76) for h-main is attributed to time management sensitivity — the width sweep explores fewer candidates on slower hardware. The control-negative scored within 1 point of prediction, validating the measurement pipeline.
